rows.label: tlk70000071_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Heaven's Holy Grail holds
unspeakable power... It's
scary when you think about it.

rows.label: tlk70000071_03_msg0002
rows.name:
But the capital isn't the only place
suffering terribly this time.

rows.label: tlk70000071_03_msg0003
rows.name:
I think you'll have heard this,
but there have been plenty of
villages attacked across Iira.

rows.label: tlk70000071_03_msg0004
rows.name:
And it isn't just Heaven's Holy Grail.
I've heard plenty of harm was done by
people taking advantage of the chaos.

rows.label: tlk70000071_03_msg0005
rows.name:
I'm not trying to play the hero of
justice, but every time I see or hear
stories like that, I get frustrated.
